hero.chip: Recorded and checked on real websites
hero.titleLabel: Interactive Tutorials Recorded From Real UI Actions
hero.intro: Tell Krama what you want to learn. It plans the steps, does the task in a real browser, checks every step, and turns it into an interactive guide with narration and focal zoom.

realSite.title: Done on the real site
realSite.text: Krama drives a real browser on the real website, so the tutorial shows exactly what you will see.

checked.title: Every step checked
checked.text: After each step Krama checks the page really changed, so a tutorial never teaches a step that failed.

replay.title: Interactive replay
replay.text: Step-by-step guides with narration, captions, highlights and zoom. Passwords and private fields are masked.

safety.title: Hands off the red button
safety.text: Deleting, transferring or publishing always waits for your OK, right before the click. CAPTCHAs stop the run.

drift.title: Tutorials that notice change
drift.text: Krama re-checks saved tutorials, heals renamed buttons and flags flows that changed.

how.chip: From a question to a tutorial in about a minute
how.title: How it works

ask.title: Ask
ask.text: Write what you want to learn, e.g. “Show me how to create a GitHub repository”.

approve.title: Approve the plan
approve.text: Krama lists every step first. Nothing runs until you approve it.

run.title: Watch it done
run.text: Krama does the task in a real browser and checks that every step worked.

learn.title: Learn from the tutorial
learn.text: Replay it step by step with narration, highlights and zoom, at your own pace.

how.cta: Stop reading stale docs. <gradient>Watch it done.</gradient>

apiStatus.label: System Status
apiStatus.offlineBanner: Backend service offline. Cached workflows and mock mode remain available.
